data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase), between an enemy unit picking its charge targets and making its [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move).

**Target:** An **ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY** unit of yours that is one of those targets.

**Effect:** Provided no enemy unit is in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of the unit and every model in it is up to 3" from an **ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT** of yours, the unit can [embark](vsdata:core-rule/embarking) in that **TRANSPORT**.
